how_to_apply: Visit the official ADA website at https://ada.gov.in and register online for the Project Assistant-I engagement, selecting the relevant Engineering Discipline and qualification criteria.
Complete the online registration on or before 13th August 2026, 1700 hrs.

Separately fill the application form in the prescribed format, affix a recent passport-size photograph on the top right corner of the first page, and keep it ready along with originals and self-attested copies of all supporting documents.
Frequently check the ADA website for the confirmed written test/interview date, as the tentative dates (16th, 23rd, or 30th August 2026) may be finalised based on the number of registered candidates.

Report for the written test/interview in Bangalore on the notified date, carrying the duly filled application form, original documents, self-attested copies, original Aadhaar card, a scientific calculator (for the written test), and an NOC from the employer if currently employed in a Government department/PSU/Autonomous Body.

Note: Online registration alone does not constitute a complete application. Candidates must still bring a duly filled application form along with all relevant supporting documents when reporting for the written test/interview.
important_instructions: Only Indian Nationals can apply for this engagement. The engagement is on a tenure basis and confers no right, implicit or explicit, for continuation beyond tenure, absorption, or regularisation in ADA. ADA reserves the right to operate the selection panel flexibly across disciplines for available and future anticipated vacancies, based on its requirement, for a period of six months. Qualification and age will be reckoned as on the closing date of registration, i.e., 13th August 2026. Carrying electronic items such as mobile phones, pen drives, or smart watches is strictly prohibited inside the ADA campus/venue for the written test. No TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview/written test, irrespective of the outcome of selection. Misrepresentation or falsification of facts detected at any stage of the selection process, or misconduct/misbehaviour during or after selection, will result in cancellation of candidature without notice and may lead to legal action. Part-time experience, apprenticeship training, periods of training, teaching experience, or experience as a trainee will not be counted toward the required years of relevant experience. Only registered candidates will be permitted to appear for the written test/interview; however, registration alone is not considered a complete application.

content_sections.heading: ADA Project Assistant-I Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals can apply for ADA Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026. Candidates must hold the educational qualification, from a recognised University, applicable to their chosen engineering discipline and qualification pathway, as detailed below. Qualification and age are reckoned as on the closing date of registration, i.e., 13th August 2026. Each discipline offers multiple qualification pathways, and the selection method (Interview Only, or Shortlisting by Written Test followed by Interview) depends on the pathway a candidate qualifies under. All qualifications must be in First Class. The notification specifies that part-time experience, apprenticeship training, periods of training, teaching experience, or experience as a trainee will not be counted when calculating the number of years of relevant experience. The exact number of years of age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates is not specified in the official notification; candidates should refer to the applicable Government of India rules or contact ADA for details. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: ADA Project Assistant-I Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection method depends on the qualification pathway a candidate falls under, as shown in the Qualification table above: Interview Only: Applicable to candidates with a valid GATE score, M.E/M.Tech from an IIT/NIT, or (for Computer Science and Electronics & Communication Engineering) B.Sc + M.Sc with a valid GATE/NET score. Shortlisting by Written Test followed by Interview: Applicable to candidates qualifying through other routes, such as B.E/B.Tech with M.E/M.Tech, B.E/B.Tech with 2 years of relevant experience, or B.E/B.Tech alone. The written test will follow the same syllabus as GATE for the relevant discipline and will have negative marking for wrong answers. Candidates are advised to bring a scientific calculator to the written test. Both the written test and interview will be conducted in Bangalore, on dates published on the ADA website based on the number of registered candidates.

Frequently check the ADA website for the confirmed written test/interview date, as the tentative dates (16th, 23rd, or 30th August 2026) may be finalised based on the number of registered candidates. Report for the written test/interview in Bangalore on the notified date, carrying the duly filled application form, original documents, self-attested copies, original Aadhaar card, a scientific calculator (for the written test), and an NOC from the employer if currently employed in a Government department/PSU/Autonomous Body. Note: Online registration alone does not constitute a complete application. Candidates must still bring a duly filled application form along with all relevant supporting documents when reporting for the written test/interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is ADA Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification (Advt No. ADA:ADV-138:2026) issued by the Aeronautical Development Agency, Ministry of Defence, for the tenure-basis engagement of 111 Project Assistant-I positions across seven engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many Project Assistant-I vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 111 tentative (including anticipated) vacancies: 15 in Computer Science Engineering, 20 in Electronics & Communication Engineering, 10 in Aeronautical Engineering, 20 in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, 43 in Mechanical Engineering, 1 in Metallurgy Engineering, and 2 in Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to register for ADA Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online registration closes on 13th August 2026 at 1700 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ADA Project Assistant-I?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years, as on 13th August 2026, with age relaxation available for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for ADA Project Assistant-I?
faq.answer: Candidates need a First Class B.E/B.Tech (or equivalent, depending on discipline) from a recognised university, with additional pathways involving a valid GATE/NET score, M.E/M.Tech from an IIT/NIT, or relevant work experience, depending on the discipline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for ADA Project Assistant-I?
faq.answer: Candidates with only a B.E/B.Tech (First Class) receive Rs. 31,000/- per month plus HRA, while all other candidates (with higher qualifications or experience) receive Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA, as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the tenure of the ADA Project Assistant-I engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is initially for two years, extendable by up to two more years (one year at a time), subject to satisfactory performance as assessed by a Review Committee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ADA Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is either through an interview only, or through shortlisting by a written test (with the same syllabus as GATE) followed by an interview, depending on the qualification pathway the candidate falls under.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the ADA written test/interview be held?
faq.answer: The written test and interview will be conducted in Bangalore, on dates that will be published on the ADA website based on the number of registered candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for ADA Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application or registration fee.
